package main

import "example.com/fixture/internal/runtime"

const conductorSection = "conductor"

func lookup(m map[string]interface{}, key string) interface{} { return m[key] }

// spillOn reads [conductor] through a helper and a const section name.
func spillOn(cfg *runtime.Config) interface{} {
	return lookup(cfg.Extra, conductorSection)
}

// everything ranges over the whole tree.
func everything(cfg *runtime.Config) int {
	n := 0
	for range cfg.Extra {
		n++
	}
	return n
}
